## Checklist

- [ ] One thing per pull request
- [ ] Engine changes (GridCraft, WordCraft) are a commit on our fork's branch (`starsheets` or `stardocs`), the app's `upstream.pin` bumped, and a row in its docs/upstream.md
- [ ] Tests pass (`cargo test` in the app's folder: `starsheets/` or `stardocs/`)
- [ ] The app's CHANGELOG.md "Unreleased" updated if people will notice the change
